Describe.301060018: Spartan series military body armor by 926 Equipment. Extensively tested in the field, this armor is known to be reliable. Its straps and shoulder pads use padded mesh for enhanced comfort and ventilation. This armor is known for its appearance as much as anything else.

Describe.401030102: A combat-ready bandage made by the 926 Company. Keeps wounds clean, allowing them to heal faster.

Describe.401040008: This rapid first aid kit from 926 Equipment is specially designed for rescue crews. It's useful in disaster rescue missions.
Describe.301050014: A military-grade bulletproof mask produced by 926 Equipment by taking existing bulletproof mask designs and adding thickened frontal protection. It offers excellent defense and is sturdy and durable, but due to its special connection structure, it can only be used on some helmets.
Describe.301010107: A tactical field vest made by 926 Equipment that is ideal for both survival and field combat. Has capacity for a large amount of ammo and supplies.
Describe.301010116: An upgraded field vest made by 926 Equipment. The only disadvantage is that the wearer may end up carrying a lot of stuff they don't need.
Describe.301010202: A widely-used integrated bulletproof vest made by 926 Equipment.
Describe.301010109: A lightweight, ergonomic chest rig made by 926 Equipment. It is designed for carrying a few small-caliber magazines and vital medical items.
Describe.301050002: A universal bulletproof mask made by 926 Equipment, compatible with most security and military helmets that employ universal tactical adapters. Affordable and provides basic protection, greatly increasing survivability of Dark Zone operators.
Describe.301050001: A universal bulletproof mask made by 926 Equipment, compatible with most security and military helmets that employ universal tactical adapters. Provides enhanced protection without additional encumbrance or affecting the wearer's vision.
Describe.301050005: A premium bulletproof mask made by 926 Equipment, designed for close combat operations. Blocks low caliber military rifle rounds. Typically used on heavy duty combat helmets. Not very versatile.

Describe.301010224: The AL armored rigs are top-level armored rigs customized for special operations units by Break Point Zero, in order to increase market popularity. Among them, the AL Commander armored rig is the flagship model. It ranks among the best in the series for load capacity and protection power. Kurt was stationed in Espinos as Colom Overseas Commissioner, responsible for the recruitment and training of secret service personnel. Describe.498060001: The "Space Lab" was a complex toy meant to help educate children about space. Produced by a toy manufacturer in Colom, it was delicately crafted—and extremely expensive. Less than a year after Space Lab was released, consumers discovered the toy came packaged with a small bottle of caustic, highly poisonous rocket propellant, after which it was quickly pulled from shelves by the Toy Association.
Describe.498080012: ■■■ is a non-Newtonian fluid-like energy-matter composite, adhered to the foundational space-time continuum of ■■■■. It manifests as a constantly surging dark luster. It possesses extremely powerful meme-distorting properties and can erode reality. Based on the conclusions of existing research papers, we theorize that ■■■ "edits" the laws of physics it comes into contact with, making them more unstable and susceptible to the observer's consciousness. There is now sufficient evidence to suggest ■■■ is the source and basic compositional material of the vast majority of strange phenomena recorded in ■■■■. To prevent the spread of this memetic hazard, we have named ■■■ "Chaotic Matter."
Describe.408130001: A worn, scratched badge. In Renoir's eyes, it has long ceased to symbolize honor.
Describe.408030018: Large capacity flash drive; potentially contains important data.
Describe.408050035: A can opener with handles. The metal is dull and has rust marks, while the blade area is stained with the residue of unidentifiable food.
Describe.201040302: A foldable Gorod adapter. Allows PT series stocks to be attached to the AK-100.
Describe.201040306: An Onotos Production adapter. Allows PT series stocks to be attached to the AKM.
Describe.408060051: A slightly bent metal spoon. The tip is covered in scratches, as though someone once used it as a shovel.
Describe.301020020: A retro marching pack. Features basic fabrics and a practical design. Durable and capacious.
Describe.408090014: A torn-open tissue box with the Northridge Observation Deck logo printed on the front. A corner of the outside of the box has been torn back, revealing a letter written underneath. The handwriting is scribbled and distorted, and part of it is smudged from what looks like tears, giving an indication of the writer's state of mind at the time.
Describe.408050001: A scrapped electric drill. The charging interface has been damaged.
Describe.408060037: A mini hearing aid; helps the hearing-impaired in daily conversations. Not for use as a tactical earpiece.
Describe.408130009: A bunch of old-fashioned cell keys with the words "Mine Jailhouse" engraved on the inside of the keychain. When the flames of war reached the hills of Onotos, Porrero and his companions capitalized on the opportunity to take over the jailhouse, giving Porrero his first taste of power. Unfortunately, this moment of triumph did not last long for Porrero.
Describe.408080050: A jade bracelet made of vibrant, dense, and flawless beads with a superior texture.
Describe.408060020: Some colored glass marbles. Childhood companions.
Describe.301060002: Bulky vintage air force body armor in excellent condition. It incorporates steel bulletproof lining to form a large protective area. It was regarded as a very good bulletproof vest back in the day.
Describe.301060039: Tan camouflage body armor from Gorod Industrial. Lightweight, yet strong, it features a bulletproof aramid layer. Suitable for patrols and other day-to-day tasks.
Describe.301060034: A ceramic bulletproof vest with camouflage, suited to jungle warfare. Often used by Rangers, it has a nylon belt for the attachment of various tools.
Describe.498080022: A finely crafted marionette, it can move its limbs without a person's input. The movements are minute and follow no discernible pattern, making it impossible to currently determine how it's moving. It's recommended that in the long term, it should be stored in a monitored environment. The tiny, carved features of the marionette's face bear a striking resemblance to a girl who went missing while traveling.
Describe.702010912: Special riding goggles with lateral vents that help to prevent fogging.
Describe.702010920: Early aviator safety goggles with green lenses and a hinged steel frame that still works. Rubber padding creates a seal around the eyes, while green lenses filter visible light, absorbing UV and IR rays.
Describe.408060019: A set of playing cards covered with dust, but unpacked.
Describe.702010915: Trendy retro aviator goggles combining rubber components, metal frames, and extended lenses.
Describe.408070015: A bag of cotton balls for medical use. A survival item that's extremely popular among militants.
Describe.408010015: A bundle of Nitrocellulose, an important ingredient in ammo manufacturing. Keep it dry and away from heat.
Describe.408060029: A pack of tissues can be used several times.
Describe.408060007: A roll of clean double-layer toilet paper.
Describe.408090015: A pile of sticky notes. Stuck together with a weak non-drying adhesive, they are easy to peel off.
Describe.408090011: A stack of yellow missing person notices with a picture of a young man printed in the middle. According to the text on the notices, a 23-year-old man named Callum travelled to Northridge then disappeared during the conflict. After the North-South Conflict died down, Callum's older brother Gavin came to the Onotos Mountains, handing out and posting these notices all over Northridge in the hope of finding his little brother.
Describe.408030026: A professional studio monitor. In the current environment, its high-quality components are in great demand among mod workshops.
Describe.408130006: A set of rather heavy brass knuckles. While it has seen years of use, it has obviously been well cared for by its owner. Although Rolf, ever the combat enthusiast, has since moved on to handier weapons, he still carries this reminder of the past.
Describe.498080020: An old CRT television that can be turned on even when not plugged in to a power source. Once on, though, the screen is always in a state of malfunction, alternating between static and distorted images. Tests have shown that observers see subtly different things in the glitching footage.
Describe.404020033: An unopened pizza. The smell and warmth are coming through the box. It tastes better warm, so eat it fast!
Describe.498080018: A massive sintered clay tablet, dark brown and with slightly chipped edges. Its surface is engraved with gold cuneiform and astrological symbols. There's an image of a prophet in the center, flanked by vivid, precise, golden reliefs of Aries and Taurus. Research indicates this tablet resembles the astronomical records of an ancient river valley civilization, making it one of humanity's earliest astronomy documents.
Describe.498080016: A large piece of meteorite with a smooth cross-section, small enough that an adult could hold it with both hands. It's entirely deep iron-gray in color and has a large, translucent, yellowish-brown crystal structure embedded in its center, which emits a warm, amber-like luster under light. After this meteorite was purchased at an auction by a wealthy Kamona merchant, it was named the "Amber Heart of Heaven."
Describe.408060006: A common soap. It's not edible.
Describe.408130010: An old Blackgold dog tag, which has accompanied Randall into many a battle since he left the Ocean Alliance special forces.
Describe.498020001: A cut of arched corrugated steel plate, displayed in stores. It's covered in a rust-proof layer, and a numbered tag is affixed to the corner. In Kamona, samples of building materials like this are often harder to come by than the finished products.
Describe.408030021: An ultra-high speed chip that is the core device of high-precision electronics.
Describe.408020022: Effective, high-quality decorative acoustic panels for noise absorption.
Describe.408080039: A forged sculpture made of plaster and gold. The exquisite details show that its maker was a master of their craft. According to the locals, the sculpture was once used as a decoration in a Marulos party and was the brightest star of the night.
Describe.408080001: A golden cheetah running. Or maybe it's a leopard?
Describe.408080032: An ancient map depicting a fabled island off the western coast of Kamona. According to legend, a rich man from Kamona had hidden all of his gold on this island. The island later disappeared. The only proof that it had ever existed is this map that has been handed down through the generations.
Describe.498080013: A spirit photograph taken of ■■■■. The photo shows a strangely shaped humanoid creature. According to rumors, its true identity is that of an operator from a squad that was carrying out a ■■ mission in ■■■■.
Describe.408090013: An unused cable car ticket with the Onotos cable car logo printed on the front and some dark, murky stains on the back. The cable car on the Observation Deck links Northridge and the town of Onotos at the foot of the mountains, allowing people to quickly get off at Onotos and enjoy the beautiful views of the Onotos mountains. Before the North-South Conflict, some lucky people took the cable car to leave Northridge from here and avoided the war completely.
Describe.408090012: A postcard with a picture of the Northridge Hotel on it. On the postcard, Callum has written what he saw and heard on his journey to Northridge, as well as about his excitement after finding a new job. At the end of his note, he describes that after his trip, he's planning on visiting the person he's sending the postcard to.
Describe.408130008: A section of streamer cut off from a military cap. The emblem of the Northern Front Navy can still be vaguely seen on its edge. Once upon a time, Derwin was extremely proud of the fact that he was in the navy, and it was for this reason that he fought in Guoyapos for such a long time. However, after the commander of the Second Clan left the Northern Front, Captain Karl decided to sink the ship Polaris, then under repair, and return to the north with everyone and the deputy commander. Derwin defied the order to sink the Polaris, and subsequently took over control of the ship and the Port along with his followers, thus becoming a force to be reckoned with in the eastern waters of the Dark Zone.
Describe.405020015: Key to a house in Northridge N. Village.
Describe.405020001: A key for hotel room 207 on the second floor of Northridge Hotel Building A, currently being used as an armory.
Describe.405010004: A key to room 201 in the outer corridor on the second floor of the Farm Motel.
Describe.405010904: A key to room 201 in the outer corridor on the second floor of the Farm Motel.
Describe.101010006: A compact rifle made by Gorod with a side folding stock. An export variant of the AK series suitable for mid-range combat environments. Uses 5.56x45mm ammo.
Describe.408060036: A plain razor; for best results use plenty of foam and shave at an angle.
Describe.408080042: Before the war, this exquisitely handmade hunting knife was often carried around as a symbol of courage and wealth. Yet now, the hunting knife here may be proof that a luxurious personal weapon is useless in the face of a collective crisis.
Describe.408130002: A well-crafted saber. For Ajax, it represents that he has the approval of powerful people.
Describe.405010008: An old key to the recycling management office under the Farm Bridge.
Describe.101050002: A fully automatic recoil-operated firearm manufactured by Helka. Can be fired from a tripod. Uses 7.62x51mm ammo.
Describe.403010001: Stacks of Koen in different denominations bound by rubber bands. Hopefully they will come in handy.
Describe.408020003: A round of adhesive tape, which is very useful in wrapping packages.
Describe.408090010: A workman's diary with the logo of Kamona Petroleum. The author is a man named Desmond. The first half records the events of the conflict in Guoyapos. The words within might be silent, but you can almost hear the gunfire and the weeping echoing off the page. The latter half of the book is just as heart-wrenching, but the content becomes touching and sentimental. The diary ends with the following sentence: "What is the world outside Kamona like? I'd like to take a look." Not long ago, the author went to the Department Store to get a gift for his friend's kid and never returned to Twilight Apartment.
Describe.408090004: Strange writings and graphs in an unmarked folder. It's in English, but you barely understand any of it. The word "Gungnir" appears multiple times. First found in the farm.
Describe.408090016: An old book. Its cover shows the passage of time but you can still make out its title. The densely packed annotations and dog-eared pages inside may never see the light of day again.
Describe.498080019: A necklace with several massive aquamarine gems as its centerpieces, accented by a multitude of crushed diamonds. The main gems are a translucent aquamarine hue, almost entirely free of impurities, while the tightly encircled diamonds create a layered halo effect. Legend has it that the aquamarine pieces came from a giant uncut gemstone, named "Mercury," that was unearthed in a Kamona mine and of a quality previously unseen in the region. A wealthy local merchant funded its cutting and polishing and commissioned a renowned jeweler to craft this necklace. Naming it the "Star of Kamona," the merchant intended it to be a symbol of home. However, ever since its creation, every one of its owners has been drawn into conflict and each time it changed hands, it was accompanied by struggle and ruin.
Describe.408080023: An obnoxious chain made of Onotos gold; local artisans make it to reflect the owner's wealth and ability.
Describe.408130011: A roughly made wooden top with a name indistinctly carved into the side, many members of the Mad Dogs wonder why their hard-as-nails boss bothers to carry it around.
Describe.408130003: A gold ring that Fred keeps close. While the weight of the ring can be felt, the person it represents will never return. He lost the original ring in the Siege of Onotos then later, captured the Onotos gold mine and ordered a famous local goldsmith to use the gold there and recreate it based on Fred's memory.
Describe.408140021: An ordinary data cable that can be used to transfer data between computers.
Describe.408090019: A collection of torn-apart Gungnir blueprint fragments. The contents seem to include sections of an enormous rail, whose design is consistent with the international standard launcher and has not been adapted for any specific country or region.
Describe.201040101: A Gorod PT1 series stock. Requires a dedicated AK series PT adapter.
Describe.201040102: A Gorod PT3 series stock. Requires a dedicated AK series PT adapter.
Describe.401050003: An injection containing a hormone that restores a small amount of HP over a short period of time. A cheap and effective first aid solution for the battlefield.

Describe.201060118: A sight rail that can be installed on the iron sight. Only compatible with the Mosin 730mm barrel.
Describe.401030201: A simple and lightweight surgical pack. Includes only basic surgical tools for patching up injuries to restore a small amount of HP.
Describe.408140014: A radio with poor sound quality.
Describe.408140024: A new kind of computer that has exploded in popularity overseas. While it is highly portable, it also commands a rather hefty price tag. Only a few wealthy families are likely to buy it.
Describe.405020014: This key opens the Cafeteria Storage in the Camp Service Center.
Describe.405020080: Key to the Cashier's Office in the Observation Deck Cafeteria. Several valuables are inside.
Describe.405020980: Key to the Cashier's Office in the Observation Deck Cafeteria. Several valuables are inside.
Describe.408130021: Maxim's attempt at a homemade drone after testing a recon model. The design goal was to compress its size and noise to the absolute limit. Of course, whether he actually succeeded is another matter entirely.
Describe.405010003: Key to the warehouse near the Farm Stables.
Describe.405010903: Key to the warehouse near the Farm Stables.
Describe.408080022: Marsden's son always dreamed about being a cowboy so, for his 12th birthday, Marsden got a blacksmith in the next town to make him a set of spurs. On the day of his son's birthday, Marsden got up early and headed to the blacksmith's. But then, he suddenly heard gunfire as he was returning to the Farm.
Describe.702010909: Special cycling goggles with brown lenses that absorb UV light and blue light wavelengths. They also feature a high-grade anti-glare coating.
Describe.201060120: A 34mm sight mount for high-power sights. Can be installed on Picatinny rails. The top of the sight mount includes a short rail for the installation of low-magnification sights.
Describe.405070902: Keycard for VIP Reception. Can open the locked room in VIP Reception in the Control Tower. Some items have been left inside.
Describe.201030102: A premium holographic sight. Well-designed and compatible with a wide range of weapons.
Describe.201070104: A premium lightweight suppressor. Provides improved recoil and noise control.
Describe.498050001: A high-frequency coil is a type of distributed-parameter, series-resonant transformer capable of handling over one million volts. Among hobbyists, this device is known as an "artificial lightning spitter."
Describe.408080041: A golden serpent coiled tightly around some ore. Grab the wealth that falls into your lap and never let it go!
Describe.408020018: A brass metal pipe that is great for water supply piping.
Describe.201040147: A black collapsible stock. Its generic design allows it to be installed on compatible assault rifles and buffer tubes.
Describe.201100070: A dedicated standard upper receiver for the A545.
Describe.201070323: A dedicated compensator for the A545. Once installed, it modifies the weapon's basic lateral recoil.
Describe.291050021: A 30-round transparent magazine for the A545.
Describe.101010032: This successor to the AEK rifle series retains the signature balanced recoil of the AEK and boasts a high rate of fire.
Describe.191010004: The AK-15SC is the folding-barrel variant of the AK-15, Gorod's latest assault rifle. Uses 7.62×39mm caliber ammo. It is frequently issued to frontline troops for assault missions.
Describe.291030607: A folding front sight for the HK.
Describe.291030606: A folding rear sight for the HK.
Describe.291040132: A modern tactical stock for the MCX assault rifle.
Describe.498140005: The first clamshell laptop introduced by MRID, and the world's first portable computer of its kind. It features a dark gray magnesium alloy body, with a rugged industrial design bearing the distinct mark of its era. Thanks to its sturdy magnesium alloy casing and solid-state storage technology, this machine was purchased by both the Colom military and the Colom Space Agency right after its launch, and used as onboard equipment for space shuttles executing low Earth orbit missions.
Describe.291030609: A folding front sight for the SI.
Describe.291030608: A folding rear sight for the SI.
Describe.291050020: A 45-round extended magazine for the UMP45 micro SMG.
Describe.291070217: An integrated muzzle for the UMP45 micro SMG.
Describe.291110020: A dedicated extended barrel for the UMP45 micro SMG.
Describe.291040131: A collapsible stock for the UMP45 micro SMG.
Describe.291070106: A special suppressor for the UMP45 micro SMG.
Describe.291040130: A modern folding stock for the UMP45 micro SMG.
Describe.291080026: A modern metal handguard for the UMP45 micro SMG.
Describe.291080027: A modern polymer handguard for the UMP45 micro SMG.
Describe.498060005: Northern Stars is an aged, fruit-infused fermented beverage crafted by a long-established Tevilan distillery. Rumor has it that its recipe contains rare local wild berries and distilled alpine spring water, and that it was once reserved only for the high-ranking officials of the Northern Military Region. Each bottle is packed in an exquisite handmade walnut mechanical box. Later, the original distillery was shut down during the war, and both the recipe for Northern Stars and the box's unique craftsmanship were lost forever.
Describe.498090009: A bundle of rice paper. The paper is delicate and flexible, with slightly yellowing edges. Originally from an Eastern country, it made its way into Kamona through trade channels before eventually ending up in the Dark Zone.
Describe.498080025: A rare double-necked lute carved entirely from a single piece of mammoth ivory. The body features intricate relief carvings depicting excerpts from the heroic epic of Ostur III from the era of the Tevilan Empire. This lute was originally a family heirloom of a fallen noble family in southern Tevila. It changed hands several times during the war before it eventually found its way into the Dark Zone. Rumor has it that the noble attempted to flee to Colom with the lute but was detained at a border checkpoint, separating the instrument from its owner. Due to its precious material and intricate craftsmanship, it continues to fetch an extremely high price on the black market.
Describe.498080026: A transverse flute finely carved from a solid piece of emerald jade. The flute's body is translucent and smooth, with the edges of the embouchure and finger holes polished to perfection. Natural jade patterns can be faintly seen flowing like clouds. A collector in Kamona with a passion for Eastern music spent a fortune purchasing this flute from an Eastern country.
Describe.498090008: A handmade dried-flower bookmark, with carefully selected flowers and leaves meticulously sealed in transparent film. Two names are written in fine ink along the edge: Marta and Valentina. Marta had made this dried-flower bookmark for her friend, and the two had agreed that Valentina would come to pick it up the next day. That evening, however, there was an unusual howling outside the house. Marta set aside the finished bookmark to go see what it was—and never returned. The next day, Valentina also didn't show up as planned, and the bookmark remained right where it was, like an undelivered letter.
Describe.498010003: A dark metal rod with a black striker. Scraping the magnesium rod produces high-temperature sparks, making it a reliable fire-starting tool for the wilderness—especially useful in wet conditions.
Describe.498040002: A rechargeable Ni-Cd battery pack. Compared to regular rechargeable batteries, it offers excellent high-current discharge performance and better resistance to overcharging or over-discharging.
Describe.498040004: Special battery packs. They are expensive and reliable.
Describe.498070013: A mass of mutated tissue shed from a mutant. The cross-section still retains distinct muscle fibers, while the surface exhibits the distinctive mutant crystallization and tarring characteristics.
Describe.498070011: Rumor has it that shortly after the zombie disaster broke out, Toland rapidly developed a Pheromone Test Kit in secret. By injecting different pheromones, users can influence the behavioral tendencies of mutants within range and also evade mutant attacks for a certain period. It is said that this kit was only issued in small quantities to supervisory personnel and frontline special forces squads.
Describe.408050039: A small blowtorch powered by a portable fuel canister. It's a handy tool for starting engines on cold winter mornings, searing a ham, or even lighting a cigar.
Describe.902050160: Use to get Basic Elite Privileges for 30 days.
Describe.491050013: Use it to significantly enhance your physique. It increases the HP limit of the abdomen and all four limbs. This is an improved version obtained through research at the Workbench, featuring an extended duration.
Describe.491050014: Use it to immediately heal limb injuries and other debuffs. You'll also obtain enhanced regeneration and faster HP recovery. This is an improved version obtained through research at the Workbench, featuring an extended duration.
Describe.391040002: To celebrate the Autumn Festival, Kamona locals thought it would be fun to carve a bunch of pumpkins. Some hollowed-out pumpkins are now being worn as costume helmets.
Describe.391040003: To celebrate the Autumn Festival, Kamona locals thought it would be fun to carve a bunch of pumpkins. Some hollowed-out pumpkins are now being worn as costume helmets.
Describe.291070107: A 556×45mm-caliber suppressor designed based on the MCX assault rifle platform.
Describe.498070010: A mutant heart sample sealed inside a biomass constant-temperature storage container. This valuable mutant sample was acquired by a Sumek Committee zombie rapid response team during a large-scale extermination mission. The sample's structure is well-preserved and highly mutated, making it of immense research value.
Describe.498090007: A conventional manufacturing blueprint. The paper's edges are slightly curled, and several key parameters have been altered with correction tape. An essential material for conducting formula research at the Workbench in your Trophy Room. They can often be found in various document boxes, clothing, and drawers.
Describe.498070009: An infrared therapy lamp manufactured by Elisir Medicina. The green metal lampshade is mounted on an adjustable support rod. Once turned on, it heats the filament, emitting a dark red light and thermal radiation. Formerly a standard fixture in Colom clinics and rehabilitation rooms, it has become a scarce commodity in the Dark Zone, valued for both its warmth and relief from lingering injuries.
Describe.491050015: Elisir Medicina once developed an experimental ultra-strength treatment, codenamed "Y3O." Although it could rapidly repair human tissue, it also caused severe side effects, and the company ultimately abandoned the project. Years later, a treatment named "Y4O" quietly appeared on the black market, and it had even stronger effects. This is an improved version obtained through research at the Workbench, which weakens the side effect of reducing maximum HP in each body part.
Describe.498040003: A handheld capacitance analyzer featuring a small LCD screen on the front. Commonly used to measure capacitor values and detect electrical leakage in circuits.
Describe.498070012: Following the zombie disaster, Toland provided the Committee with a batch of blockers and specialized Blocker Injectors. During the early stages of a mutant virus infection, administering the blocker can stop the virus from spreading and even render it inactive over time.
Describe.498060006: An access card issued to R&D personnel in Toland's Zombie Division. This card grants laboratory staff clearance, allowing the holder to access key areas throughout the facility.
Describe.498090011: A zombie incident report stored in the Airport Control Tower. It details the precise location of the data storage device and the password required to access it.
Describe.498090010: A hand-drawn sketch of a mutant's evolutionary process left behind by a Bay Area resident trapped at Guoyapos Airport. The drawing details the physical changes of the infected at different stages, as well as their complete form upon finally becoming a mutant. In a later investigation, a purge squad found the author of this sketch in front of a mirror in the airport restroom.
Describe.498100006: A handheld calculator made by Chapman. It features a dark body, a monochrome LCD screen, and hard plastic keys for basic scientific calculations.
Describe.498040001: A portable solar charger developed by Chapman. Capable of storing, charging, and supplying power alongside being waterproof for outdoor use.
Describe.291110023: An AK-15SC integrated suppressor made by Gorod.
Describe.291100014: An AK-15SC upper receiver made by Gorod.
Describe.291080025: An AK-15SC dedicated handguard made by Gorod.
Describe.291030604: An AK-15SC front sight made by Gorod.
Describe.291040129: An AK-15SC standard stock made by Gorod.
Describe.291110019: An AK-15SC standard barrel made by Gorod.
Describe.291070216: An AK-15SC flash suppressor made by Gorod.
Describe.291030605: An AK-15SC rear sight made by Gorod.
Describe.793050591: A silent front sight means prey never gets a second chance.
Describe.291110022: An experimental accessory developed by Zeta Zone Tactical, this proof-of-concept kit was designed for the FAL assault rifle. It features a taper-bore barrel design, which continuously applies pressure to the bullet as the bore narrows during firing. This maintains chamber pressure while greatly improving firing power and armor penetration. However, because part of the chamber pressure is expended to overcome the bullet's deformation, the volume of gas entering the gas block is greatly reduced, slowing the bolt cycling speed and altering the recoil pattern.
Describe.291100015: An experimental accessory developed by Zeta Zone Tactical, this special proof-of-concept module was designed for the M110 marksman rifle. This upgrade replaces the trigger with a double-shot mechanism and adds a specially shaped trigger sear. A primary round is fired by pulling the trigger, and then another is fired upon releasing it—effectively firing two shots in one cycle.
Describe.291110021: An experimental accessory developed by Zeta Zone Tactical, this proof-of-concept barrel was designed for the MPX micro SMG. It features a critical spin barrel with polygonal rifling and a matching gas system, causing bullets to become unstable and tumble immediately upon impact. This increases damage and stopping power against unarmored targets, but reduces penetration and damage when impacting armor.
Describe.291100016: An experimental accessory kit developed by Zeta Zone Tactical, designed specifically for the PCC-9 semi-automatic platform. By replacing the trigger sear and heat-adaptive upper receiver component, this kit grants the weapon fully automatic firing capability. At the same time, the heat-sensitive friction plates automatically adjust the rate of fire based on the weapon's temperature, assisting in the operator's sustained firepower while ensuring reliable performance during high-intensity use.
Describe.408080087: A mysterious stimulant that leaked shortly after the Bay Area zombie outbreak. Preliminary analysis suggests it is an artificially engineered viral solution. Its composition closely resembles that of the previously leaked "Utopia," but at a much higher concentration.
Describe.498140006: The GU-470 portable home recorder produced by Universal Communications. Thanks to its comprehensive features and excellent design, it has seen good sales in the global home recorder market.
Describe.903090050: Use to unlock rewards in the free charm event launching in S7.
Describe.901070161: A true utopia is never built on the backs of men. A commemorative badge for completing S7 Hardcore Missions.
Describe.498100005: A handheld salinity meter developed with investment from Wyllie Co., capable of quickly measuring the salt concentration in a solution.
Describe.795130065: Infiltration Mode background. A commemorative background for completing S7 Hardcore Missions.
Describe.498070006: A securely sealed active sample. After successfully bringing it out, you can unlock Research Points through Zombie Research to operate more efficiently in the Infected Zone.
Describe.498070005: A cloudy sample containing collected materials. After successfully bringing it out, you can unlock Research Points through Zombie Research to operate more efficiently in the Infected Zone.
Describe.498070007: A high-purity sample that has undergone purification. After successfully bringing it out, you can unlock Research Points through Zombie Research to operate more efficiently in the Infected Zone.
Describe.498070014: Zombie samples that were scattered across Kamona following the zombie outbreak.

Desc.1106: This small agricultural region has a flat terrain. The Motel and the Stables are the two important supply locations.
Desc.401: Northridge is located in the Onotos Mountains north of Onotos downtown. The mountain area has a magnificent view and lush vegetation. Visitors can see the snow-capped mountain in the distance and look over the small town at the foot of the mountain. The magnificent Northridge Hotel was built next to the reservoir in the mountains and is now occupied by Fred's team.
Desc.1701: As the natural deep-water harbor on the eastern coast of Guoyapos was an important import and export channel for northern Kamona, the entire Port was constructed and developed around it. During the time it was controlled by the Northern Front, the Tevilans dispatched military support to provide Kamona the help needed to build a naval port and shipyard for repairs nearby.
Desc.1601: Kamona TV Station is located in the Guoyapos region. It was the largest TV station in Kamona. During the North-South Conflict, this place was used by the Northern Front as a frontline command center. When the Dark Zone was established, it was commandeered by Sumek Committee for an unknown reason. Most of it was destroyed in the war. Only the cramped interior was left intact.
Desc.1602: Kamona TV Station is located in the Guoyapos region. It was the largest TV station in Kamona. During the North-South Conflict, this place was used by the Northern Front as a frontline command center. When the Dark Zone was established, it was commandeered by the Sumek Committee for an unknown reason. Most of it was destroyed in the war. Only the cramped interior was left intact.
Desc.1102: Located just outside Marulos, the Arbor Farm was once an important food production center in Kamona. The Grain Trade Center was set up here to facilitate the transport of grain. A rail link between northern and southern Kamona used to cross through the farm, which contributed to its prosperity. The farm was devastated during the civil war, and the rail line was destroyed. After the war ended, Ajax led the occupation of the area under orders from Renoir. Now, due to the disaster caused by mutants, the Farm has changed hands once again.
Desc.1104: Located just outside Marulos, the Arbor Farm was once an important food production center in Kamona. The Grain Trade Center was set up to facilitate the transport of grain. A rail link between northern and southern Kamona used to cross through the farm, which contributed to its prosperity. The farm was devastated during the civil war, and the rail line was destroyed. After the war ended, Ajax led the occupation of the area under orders from Renoir.
Desc.1301: Located just outside Marulos, the Arbor Farm was once an important food production center in Kamona. The Grain Trade Center was set up to facilitate the transport of grain. A rail link between northern and southern Kamona used to cross through the farm, which contributed to its prosperity. The farm was devastated during the civil war, and the rail line was destroyed. After the war ended, Ajax led the occupation of the area under orders from Renoir.
Desc.701: The Valley by the Floranpino Beach is a great tourist attraction with excellent scenery. People used to come to the beach during vacations. Villas, yachts, and cruise ships were scattered along the coastline. After several wars, it is no longer prosperous. A sudden disaster destroyed the already fragile foundation of the family's rule, leaving Doss to ponder the issue of survival.
Desc.1401: This military armory was once controlled by the Northern Front. It was stocked with weapons and protected by heavy fortifications. During the North-South Conflict, Ajax held the ground here for months until Renoir came. Now, this place is controlled by Renoir's men and heavily armed guards are scattered across the choke points of the armory to defend it from outsiders.
Desc.1101: One of the main places where the red and blue sides fight one another during Training Simulation. An agricultural production facility.
Desc.1501: One of the main places where the red and blue sides practice against another during Training Simulation. In a scenic mountainous area.
Desc.9701: The Guoyapos International Airport, located in southern Guoyapos, is a modern aviation hub. Initially, the airport mainly served tourists from abroad, but during the early stages of the North-South Conflict, it served the important role of evacuating expats. As the war progressed, it was used by both sides as a provisional frontline command center and was militarized accordingly. Now, mutants have taken advantage of the situation to occupy this vital aerial hub in southern Guoyapos.
Desc.9989: A test map for Endless Mode.

country_name.239: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands

disp_detail.9401508: The "cargo" is packed and ready! Now for a critical mission—I need you to personally haul the sample safe all the way to the TV Station. Given the current situation, the enemy shouldn't suspect you. Just keep a low profile, and don't go anywhere you shouldn't. And don't worry, we'll be watching your six.
disp_detail.9011504: Three investigations have turned up nothing. On the surface, everything in the Valley seems normal. Yet the more rumors I hear, the more I sense there's another unseen side to that place. My rational mind tells me to stop—but... Operator, make one more run for me: tell all our people in the Valley to pull out.
disp_detail.9341603: The cargo you activated the locators for has safely reached Guoyapos. The plan worked. Next, I need you to head to the Farm and activate the remaining coordinate locators. Also, the recon squad has a new report: Team Annihilation movements have changed. It seems they suspect the true motives of the White Wolf squad. We know for a fact that at least one group of operators hired by Team Annihilation is conducting a counter-investigation in Marulos. You need to stay on high alert while activating those locators. If they spot you, don't hesitate—eliminate them immediately. Leave no loose ends.
disp_detail.9431615: Expert, have you ever considered the following questions: What is humanity's ultimate fate in this Sumek Comet Crisis? To be saved, or to simply go extinct? After this operation, I hope you'll formally join Team Annihilation and become part of my squad. This is the only place you can find a ticket to the new world. Whether it's Colom or Tevila, or the politicians spouting their rhetoric in the Sumek Committee, they all cry "salvation" and offer hypocritical "aid". But look closely—who have they actually saved? At least Toland is taking action. Their methods might not be clean, but they're definitely searching for a solution. True, the experiments may lack humanity. But if nothing is done, this disaster will swallow us all. The great powers care only about profit, while Toland is the only one who cares whether enough people survive. Believe it or not, this is the company's stance.
disp_detail.9431606: Expert, do you remember that friend you met at the Observation Deck? It looks like the idiot exposed themselves. A complete waste of my previous cover. However, one should always try to make use of everything, so I think I'll bring them over to Northridge. Knowing Talia, she'll probably leave an opening for that idiot to escape, then use the opportunity to track them. I plan to play right into her hands. I'll lead their trackers right to the Viper, and then look for a chance to... plant a deeper, smarter nail.
disp_detail.9431612: Are you in position, Expert? Good. Team Annihilation has already torn a few holes in the Airport's outer defenses. I need you to cut in from the north. The White Wolves have all their attention on the south right now, so you can deal a heavy blow from behind while their guard is down.
disp_detail.9431613: Expert, there's something I haven't told you. Talia and I... we used to be really good friends. Back at the Tevila Military Academy, she was the type of person who excelled at everything. Training, tactics, command—she had no weaknesses, except that she was slightly inferior to me in special parachute jumps. I envied her back then, and even looked up to her as a role model... I suppose she might have seen me the same way. But when I had nowhere left to turn, and she was the only one who could help me, she just vanished without a trace and abandoned me! Even after all these years, I've never forgotten that past!
disp_detail.9431616: Expert, things are just about done at the Airport now. We've drawn in enough White Wolves for backup. Intel control has ceased, so they should have received the message that the Major General's special flight was diverted to the capital's Airport. We'll leave the rest of the combat to Blackgold so that they can continue to harass them. Follow the Apostle's squad and prepare for an orderly extraction. By the way, the mole just sent word—Talia's convoy has departed, and our preparations at Pier 7 are complete. After all these years apart, I hope she won't be too surprised to see me.
disp_detail.9431614: Expert, Tevila's reinforcements are here, and they're faster than expected. Talia is moving quickly over there—it seems she still has her skills. I need you to intercept them. You don't have to wipe them out completely; just delay them. Buy some time for the Apostle's operation in the Control Tower. But don't push too hard; I'll deploy a squad from Team Annihilation to coordinate with your actions.
disp_detail.9431605: The Crows pulled out just in time, and the White Wolves caught nothing but air. Just thinking about Talia's meticulously prepared airlift plan being vetoed by those incompetent Tevila superiors... it makes me laugh. Still, it seems the company is incredibly resourceful to be able to influence decisions at that level. All right, back to the mission. Talia is now left with only maritime transport options. Currently, there aren't many suitable docks for mooring in Guoyapos. I need you to keep making some noise at the Airport to confuse them. And I need to... prepare for our upcoming meeting.
disp_detail.9341608: I'll provide funds and basic supplies for the decoy op at Pier 5, but you'll need to source the required weapons and gear yourself. The Guard Corps has received lots of military aid from Tevila, including basic weapons and supplies, and I trust you've got your own way to get your hands on whatever else you'll need.
disp_detail.9401504: What?! You found traces of a suspected command squad at the Armory? That's an unexpected windfall—excellent work. Don't let them slip away! I've already contacted the local White Wolves; they'll provide you with the necessary supplies and equipment. Make sure you intercept them before they leave the Armory! I've got a strong feeling we're close to securing some critical intel.
disp_detail.9341609: It's almost time for the op. Most of the Team Annihilation strongholds in Guoyapos and Marulos have either been driven out or suppressed, so now's our best transport window. A disguised Tevila merchant ship is heading for Kamona, and I need you and your operators to execute the decoy op at Pier 5. I'll also send a squad of White Wolves to assist with the defense. Remember that you're decoys, not martyrs—if things go south, just hold your ground and wait for our reinforcements.
disp_detail.9421508: You've done an excellent job. It's safe to say Team Annihilation will be fully drawn in by this carefully designed "escape route." However, even with a complete chain of physical evidence, the story lacks credibility without an eyewitness to back it up. I'm sure you already have a good idea of how to create a convincing "eyewitness."
disp_detail.9411509: The new intel you brought back confirms my suspicions. As I suspected, this was a carefully fabricated trail. I am now certain that the Blast Squad never crossed the frontline. Move out. Notify all members of Team Annihilation in every sector to abandon their current approach and redeploy for coordinated sector-wide sweep.
disp_detail.9421506: Your work was clean and efficient. I knew I picked the right person. However, a disguise that's too perfect might arouse the Apostle's suspicion. So, I need you to make another trip to the Armory. Add a few "flaws" to what you've already set up, things that look like they were left behind in a hurry. We'll use these subtle imperfections to sell the illusion of a real escape.
disp_detail.9341606: Your investigation was effective—the traitor finally made a mistake, and I've narrowed the suspects down to just five people. He's hiding deep, but if we keep the pressure on, I'm afraid he might do something desperate, and I don't want to risk too much damage. The traitor likely knows we're onto him, so he's looking for a way out. At this point, I think it's better to guide his path than to block it. I'll leave a gap for his escape at the TV Station, and once he steps into the trap, Maxim will track him, leading us straight to his handlers.
disp_detail.9401510: See? I told you! Despite a few bumps along the way, you and the cargo made it to the TV Station safe and sound. Alright, the Warrant Officer is in charge now. I guess it's time for me to head back to the Airport and resume my post as "temporary commander." Catch you later, my friend!
disp_detail.9341510: The Apostle has retreated. Operator, congratulations—we've won. Yuri would be proud of me, and I'm proud of Maxim. Next, we'll safely transport these important goods back to Tevila. Thank you for your exceptional effort and steadfast support throughout this operation.
disp_detail.9411604: Well done. Renoir is in a rage and preparing to lock down the Armory altogether, but the Crows won't be caught in such a crude net. I'll lead the Crows out, soldier. I want you to take this opportunity to leave some "gifts" for those fools. Once you finish placing them, rendezvous at the safehouse to the south. The Crows will be waiting.
disp_detail.9431603: Beautifully done, you really do live up to the Crows' recommendation. Next, Expert, I'll need you to take a trip to the Observation Deck. A friend will be heading there to give me an answer. Oh, and by the way—if they don't leave behind any intel on those guys at the TV Station, just do me a favor and take them out. I don't need a friend who remains loyal to Tevila.
disp_detail.9401507: The Warrant Officer agrees with my assessment. She plans to join forces with the Guard Corps to intercept that "Apostle" squad. Packing up the "cargo" will take some time, so I need you to take a squad and intercept any members of Team Annihilation that might be heading back to the Farm. Do your best to hold them off and buy us more time!
disp_detail.9401604: New orders from the Warrant Officer: head to the TV Station and stand by. It's a total mess—seems like there's a traitor among the White Wolves. The Warrant Officer has narrowed down the suspect list, but hasn't caught the rat yet. You know her style—she's not one to spook a rat away. She's left an escape route open so the traitor can "safely" flee the TV Station. Our job is to tail him, confirm his identity, and he'll lead us right to his handlers.
disp_detail.9411507: A new situation has developed. The Crows have picked up the trail of the Blast Squad in the south. All signs indicate they departed via the Airport and are moving south through Marulos. I need you to go to the Farm at once to investigate and verify this intel. The Crows will be conducting their own confirmation as well.
disp_detail.9401509: Don't worry! What happened at the Farm was a complete accident—I swear I wasn't using you as bait! On the bright side, we really hammered Team Annihilation's main force, didn't we? You've probably guessed the next step—yep, we're setting another trap at the Armory to intercept any Team Annihilation squads that might be on your tail. You just focus on the delivery and leave the rest to us!
disp_detail.9411503: The outskirts of Northridge have been cleared—up to standard. Next target: the Hotel interior. I've heard of the man running the place. Never thought we'd end up on opposite sides, but times change, and so do allegiances. Let's hope he understands the situation and refrains from any meaningless resistance.
disp_detail.9041605: That Team Annihilation group in Northridge is tougher than expected. Their tactics are entirely different from before—they're more professional, ruthless, and decisive. I suspect there's been a change in their command. Keep an eye on Northridge. Don't rush in; figure out their patterns first. I'll get Espinos' intelligence officers to look into who's entered Kamona recently. I've got a feeling we'll dig something up. Stay safe out there in Northridge; these guys aren't easy to deal with.
disp_detail.9401606: Northridge? Bit of a surprise. I thought the Vipers and Forest Men were still at each other's throats up there. For Team Annihilation to have a secret stronghold in that area... I'm afraid that means they might have ties with the Abyss. You stay up in Northridge, pal, and continue investigating. I'll head back to the TV Station and meet with the Warrant Officer to plan our next move.
disp_detail.9431601: Hi, Expert. Let me formally introduce myself—I'm White Rose. My squad and I really need an experienced hand like you to help us out. The rules here are simple: I pay, you work. The price is clear, and the compensation is more than enough.
disp_detail.9401501: Hey, friend! We meet again! You guys really sold it last time, posing as a breakout squad—I almost called in fire support! Seriously, what if I had a word with the Warrant Officer and got you posted here too? Nah, forget it. I know you like your freedom... *Ahem*, let's get down to business. I'm planning to retake the strongholds one by one from the perimeter and drive those raincoat-wearing bastards back! I need you to watch my six—and make sure no other operators interfere with my plan.
disp_detail.9401601: Hey, pal! I've got a job for you. Remember that cargo I stashed in Marulos? Well, it's time to move it northward. That whole area is Guard Corps territory, as you know. Sure, we're partnered with them, but at the end of the day, we're still outsiders. All that is to say: this cargo isn't for their eyes to see. I need you to slip into the Armory and activate a set of coordinate locators—without being detected.
disp_detail.9421501: Hey, operator. You know exactly what I need from you. Toland's squad is still tracking Kurt and his team, and Revan's successor is proving tougher than we expected. The situation is clear: if we don't interfere, they’ll soon pinpoint Kurt's route. I need you to go to Marulos immediately. Create a "smokescreen" to lure Team Annihilation into dedicating more manpower to investigate the area.
disp_detail.9411521: Disrupting our showdown at a time like this... Renoir, as shortsighted as ever. No wonder he was played by the Westerners back then. "Rose" has already punched a hole through the southern line for us. Go coordinate a synchronized assault with the captain. The Crows will rendezvous with you at the right moment.
disp_detail.9341604: You can stop following the coordinate locator for now. Maxim will take over on that. Instead, I need you to head to the Airport immediately and await orders. Not long ago, Officer Vladlen's ground transport plan was rejected by high command as "unreliable", so now, my air transport plan is competing with a sea transport option. To be honest, I agree with Vladlen—ground transport is the safest bet for this op. High command's reasoning was vague but insistent, so I smell a plot. Our top priority for now is to shore up the Airport's defenses and ensure the airlift goes off without a hitch.
disp_detail.9041604: Soldier, the clues you found have paid off. We've tracked those squads to Northridge. After pulling out of the Valley, they headed straight there. I need you to go to Northridge and continue the investigation to figure out what Team Annihilation is after. Also, if you get the chance, grab a few alive. They're worth more alive; we can make them talk. You know how this works, so I won't say any more.
disp_detail.9041601: Soldier, I need you to make another trip. Head to the Valley and protect Doss. Team Annihilation has had their eyes on him lately, and the White Wolves guarding him have been taking casualties. I sent another squad of White Wolves as backup, but their convoy was ambushed en route. We're still not sure if Team Annihilation's real target is the White Wolves or Doss, but either way, we can't let the Dark Zone fall into chaos. Stick to Doss and keep him safe. While you're at it, keep an eye on Team Annihilation and see what they're plotting.
disp_detail.9411519: The alpha is on the move. She's joined forces with the Guard Corps, and we're now facing a pincer attack from both the Wolves and the Guard Corps. We're outnumbered. The Crows can no longer operate as a single unit. I'll personally lead a main squad to draw their fire. You can either follow me and fight head-on, or extract separately with the other squads.
disp_detail.9411520: The alpha's position has been locked. Her escort force is too small to withstand a decisive strike. I know full well this is likely a trap. Revan would have waited. But I'm not him. I choose to face it head-on. This is the continuation of that unfinished showdown. And Raven... will reap it all in the end.
disp_detail.9011502: The strange rumors haven't stopped; in fact, they're multiplying. I've even received a formal commission for a local investigation. It looks like a deeper look is necessary. I need you to go to the Valley and conduct a thorough field investigation to verify whether these rumors are true.
disp_detail.9401503: Good news! Renoir just sent word—they intercepted some comms chatter at the Armory. An unknown squad calling themselves "Team Annihilation" is active there. This is a rare opportunity! I'm organizing two squads: you'll take one to the Armory to do some recon, and I'll lead the other to the Farm to investigate. We'll advance on two fronts and find out exactly what they're up to!
disp_detail.9411514: Just as I predicted, the Wolves have left their den. The alpha plans to reinforce the Airport, completely blind to her predicament. With the TV Station now lightly defended, this is the perfect opportunity for you to infiltrate. Go activate the locators we planted earlier and deploy more comms interception devices.
disp_detail.9411602: You chose to stay, just as Raven predicted. Truly a soldier after my own heart. We've got a new mission. Target: the Armory. A convoy escorted by the White Wolves is set to arrive at the Armory in three days to deliver combat supplies to the Guard Corps. We need to ambush the convoy, create chaos, and degrade the White Wolves' intel capabilities.
disp_detail.9041603: Our informants in the Valley just sent word—several recon squads suspected to be from Team Annihilation recently pulled out of the Valley, their destination unknown. I want you to follow this intel and scour the Valley. Find their stronghold and see if they left anything behind. Clues, traces, anything they couldn't pack in time—find whatever you can.
disp_detail.9041602: Things in the Valley are slowly stabilizing. More White Wolves are coming down from the north as backup. But before they arrive, I need you to make another run. Take this batch of medicine and supplies to the injured White Wolf brothers. They're still waiting in the Valley, and things aren't looking good. I need you to verify their condition for me.
disp_detail.9421510: I've made contact with Kurt's squad. They urgently need fresh supplies to stay operational. However, due to Toland's continued infiltration of upper command, I can't use the CDIS logistics network to provide any official support to a squad that's been declared "eliminated." That's why I need you to go to Northridge one more time. Deliver these critical supplies to Kurt's squad at their temporary stronghold to help them out of this jam.
disp_detail.9401502: You're a lifesaver, friend! We've beaten back their offensive, and the White Wolves are retaking control of the outer strongholds. That should give the Warrant Officer a bit of breathing room. Now that the crisis at the Airport is temporarily resolved, heh heh... it's time to settle the score with these guys. According to our intel, this crew has shown up in several locations across the Dark Zone, apparently searching for something. I'm putting together two squads to go pay them a "visit"—and hopefully snag some intel while we're at it.
disp_detail.9411512: Impressive work. You've certainly earned your reputation. Even the guard battalion fears you. The primary mission is complete. And now... it is time to settle some old scores. I need you to challenge the Wolves. Break their bared fangs, force them back into their den, and make them too scared to leave it again.
disp_detail.9411612: The young wolves found a small path and bypassed the blockade we set up. They've rushed to build a defensive line inside the Terminal. These young wolves are growing fast; the Crows can't push through their defenses quickly. Soldier, I need you to lead a Vanguard squad into the Control Tower and destroy their command center. Remember—you don't need to capture it, you just need to destroy as much equipment as you can.
disp_detail.9411610: The young White Wolves have potential, but they lack experience—they're nowhere near the level of a seasoned commander. Soldier, we have now achieved our objective. Prepare to withdraw. This operation went unusually smoothly, and the intel we gathered was incredibly accurate. I'm only just now realizing that the mole has been in among the White Wolves all along. Perhaps that maniac had everything planned out before she even arrived in Kamona. It's a good thing she's our captain now.
disp_detail.9041501: Conquer these lands and make your name known to all.
disp_detail.9041502: Conquer these lands and make your name known to all.
disp_detail.9041503: Conquer these lands and make your name known to all.
disp_detail.9041504: Conquer these lands and make your name known to all.
disp_detail.9041505: Conquer these lands and make your name known to all.
disp_detail.9041607: Conquer these lands and make your name known to all.
disp_detail.9041608: Conquer these lands and make your name known to all.
disp_detail.9041609: Conquer these lands and make your name known to all.
disp_detail.9041610: Conquer these lands and make your name known to all.
disp_detail.9041611: Conquer these lands and make your name known to all.
disp_detail.9431617: With the intel control lifted, Vladlen is bound to reinvestigate the reliability of the entire network. Expert, I want you to head to the TV Station as soon as possible and destroy the intel transceiver equipment there to slow down their transmission efficiency. The intelligence officer whom the company bribed will use this window to withdraw from Kamona, cutting off their investigation at the source.
disp_detail.9341605: We were too late. The enemy assaulted the Airport early, planting doubt about the air transport plan among the high command, so they decided to opt for sea transport. The timing is just too perfect for my taste. It's like someone's secretly watching us and anticipating our every move. I don't want to believe it, but it seems that there's a traitor among us. I need you to stay at the Airport and keep an eye out for anything unusual. We need to grab this rat by the tail.
disp_detail.9341507: I just received an urgent message from Maxim. At the Farm, we found a cache of important supplies hidden by Team Annihilation—undoubtedly the core objective of the enemy's operation. We also got word from the Armory that a hostile commander, suspected to be the "Apostle," has led an elite squad in breaking through the Guard Corps' encirclement. Taken together, these unusual developments strongly suggest that this "Apostle" is the mastermind behind the entire series of attacks.
disp_detail.9401506: Holy cow! This "cargo" is some truly "rare" stuff. I've heard the Warrant Officer mention something like this before, but it shouldn't be here. It's supposed to be underground at the TV Station. Anyway, never mind the details. The real problem is that it's here. I need to report this to the Warrant Officer immediately and request instructions. Friend, take your team and conduct another thorough sweep of the area. See if you can find any more "surprises" for us.
disp_detail.9011503: I trust your judgment. The problem is, the bizarre rumors about the Valley haven't died down—they're only increasing. They might sound like cheap thrillers, but they're not coming from nowhere. Operator, I'll have to ask you to head to the Valley again. This time, focus on investigating the specific locations mentioned in the rumors and see if anything unusual is happening.
disp_detail.9411502: They may see this as an undeserved calamity, but once they chose to become accomplices, they forfeited any claim to innocence. Their arrogance is a chain that will inevitably drag them to ruin. In that sense, you and I are much alike: even when trapped, we don't curse our fate—we keep going until we find a way out.
disp_detail.9411609: You did well, soldier. The sabotage operation at the Airport was a success. In the short term, at most they'll only be able to repair a single transport runway. And the Crows have received new intel: a Task Force is departing from the wolves' den, preparing to reinforce the Airport's defenses. But by the time they arrive, all they'll find is a complete mess.
disp_detail.9411614: Prepare to fall back, soldier. We already achieved our objective, so no need to waste any more manpower here. The Crows will make an orderly withdrawal along their route. Don't worry about Blackgold; they chose this path, and they'll have to finish walking it themselves. Lead the remaining Task Forces and extract them out from the west side; I'll cover your rear from the north. Get moving; don't look back. I'll see you at the rendezvous point.
disp_detail.9411611: Soldier, get to the combat position as quickly as possible. In this operation, Blackgold will attack from the east, and you'll lead your team in from the west. Meanwhile, the Crows will attack the Terminal from the north to draw out the White Wolves from the Control Tower. Your mission is to secure the outer corridors, cut off the ground connection between the Control Tower and the Terminal, and stop the White Wolves' reinforcements from getting through. As for Blackgold, they can fight their own battles. Just focus on your own mission.
disp_detail.9411613: Keep your chin up, soldier. It wasn't your fault that the Control Tower op failed. The enemy is skilled and held the defensive advantage; getting out in one piece was already the best possible outcome. Anyway, right now I need you at the Terminal to cover the Crows' retreat. Blackgold's impact on the east side is fading, and the young wolves are turning their fire to wipe out the Crows. The goal of this Airport operation was never to take full control of it. We must save our strength for the battles to come.
disp_detail.9411501: Since you've navigated the mist and uncovered the truth I left behind, you now have the chance to work with me. Some time ago, a group of overconfident fools made a serious mistake, and those sent to clean up after them proved utterly incompetent, leaving a tangled mess. Our superiors are displeased, and the responsibility to fix it now falls squarely on our shoulders.
disp_detail.9411601: Come to Northridge, soldier. "The deadliest operator in the Dark Zone." Those were her words, not mine. I didn't accept the job in your place, but I also didn't think you'd want to pass this one up. I can't give you the details now. All I can say is that this psycho is formally my superior, and the commander of Team Annihilation's operations in the Kamona region.
disp_detail.9411605: A tactical loss doesn't mean strategic defeat. They've won this round, but don't lose heart. New orders: follow the highway to Floranpino. You're certainly familiar with Doss in the Valley. Ever since he switched factions, the White Wolves have kept him safe. Our target is not Doss himself, but rather the White Wolves protecting him, as well as the reinforcements that will surely follow. Hit them hard—so hard that they have no choice but to commit more personnel to the area. Once the enemy is mired in the wrong place, they'll be powerless to put up a fight where it really matters.
disp_detail.9411522: Our showdown was interrupted, but the threads of fate will not be severed so easily. I'm certain a more fitting stage will present itself in time. For revenge, I can afford to be patient. I will lead my team south as quickly as possible to provide support. Your mission is to hold off the Guard Corps' pursuing forces from the rear. Don't let me down.
disp_detail.9411526: I've received intel from the captain. The escort team is closing in on the TV Station. This is our last chance. I have to admit, that young wolf has grown faster than expected and is already showing signs of an alpha. The battle will be extremely dangerous. Whether you take part in this final gambit is up to you.
disp_detail.9431602: A wise decision. Welcome aboard—I hope we'll be working together for a long time. Let's start things off with an appetizer. Expert, I need you to go to Northridge and teach Fred a lesson. Find their hidden stronghold and wipe out a Forest Man squad. What? You're asking if we have some sort of grudge? Of course not. But since we just arrived in Kamona, think of it as doing a small favor for that Viper.
disp_detail.9421509: The latest intel shows we've successfully sent Team Annihilation down the wrong path. Our window of opportunity is now open. I need you to secretly go to Northridge for me and deliver the real message to Kurt's squad. The exact coordinates have been encrypted and sent to your terminal. Confirm the location as soon as possible and deliver the intel securely. They're counting on it.
disp_detail.9401607: You made it, pal! Things are a mess here. Team Annihilation has allied with Blackgold, and there's more troops here than ants at a picnic! When the Warrant Officer said you were bringing reinforcements, I nearly shed a tear! I can hold the Control Tower, but I've got zero intel on the perimeter. I need you to sweep the area and see what kind of formation they're setting up. Don't get too close—just take a peek and then retreat.
disp_detail.9401602: We've got a problem, pal. Team Annihilation ambushed our military supply convoy on the way to Renoir. Not only did we take casualties ourselves, but the Guard Corps unit in charge of receiving the cargo took heavy losses, too. Renoir's furious, and he's getting ready to mobilize the Guard Corps to lock down the Armory. Problem is, we've still got some cargo stuck inside, so we need to get our act together before that lockdown goes into full effect. You slip in there and activate the coordinate locators, then create a ruckus so my guys can move the rest of the cargo out while the guards are distracted.
disp_detail.9401609: Something's off, pal. The Major General's plane diverted to Kamona Capital Airport half an hour ago, but they only notified us just now. That means he never planned to land here, but they hid that fact until the last moment. I tried to contact the Warrant Officer, but our comms don't work. Interference, cutting in and out... That's not normal. Could Team Annihilation be jamming our comms? I'll try the TV Station again and see if they can pass a message to the Warrant Officer.
disp_detail.9401608: Team Annihilation has infiltrated the Control Tower. Not many, but they've got skills, pal. They must be planning to take out our command center. The battle is raging at the Terminal, but I can't spare any of my squad, so I need you to go there and wipe them out—every last one of 'em. I've got to keep the landing strip secure until the Major General's plane lands, so once you clear that squad out, hurry over and bolster the White Wolves' defenses at the Control Tower.
disp_detail.9431611: Our window of opportunity has opened. The company has obtained accurate intel: a Tevila Major General will arrive at Guoyapos Airport on a special flight early the day after tomorrow to oversee the cargo transport. We need to strike the Airport first and stop the flight from landing. Talia will be forced to dispatch the White Wolves for backup. To guarantee success on both fronts, we need more manpower. Expert, I need you to contact Blackgold and hire a group of top-tier fighters for combat the day after tomorrow. Soon, I'll give Talia a taste of what it's like to be betrayed by those closest to her.
disp_detail.9341502: The situation at the Airport is grim. The commander there was killed in an ambush while leading a support team out to reinforce the outer strongholds. The remaining forces have fallen back to their strongholds to dig in. Right now, aside from the control tower area, the defensive line at the outer strongholds is on the brink of collapse. Under the emergency protocol, I've dispatched an Emergency Squad to reinforce the Airport. Before they arrive, I need you to determine the identity, strength, and intentions of these hostiles.
disp_detail.9421507: The Airport is the starting point of this false trail. It was recently taken over by the White Wolf Squad. This period of chaotic transition is the perfect cover for all sorts of traces to "logically" appear. I'll leave the rest to you. Use your judgment and create as many convincing "traces" as you see fit.
disp_detail.9431610: As expected, Talia didn't suspect there was another nail near her, and it was thanks to that we were able to learn the details of their next plan. Pier 7 is the final chosen transport dock; Pier 5 is just a decoy. But right now, we still don't have a good solution for our disadvantage in numbers. I'll report back to Toland to see if they can create an opportunity to divide the White Wolves' forces in Guoyapos.
disp_detail.9041606: Found it. A group did enter Kamona recently—guys with serious military backgrounds, mostly Colom or Ocean Alliance special ops. After arriving in Kamona, they quickly left the capital and went off-grid. I have reason to believe these guys make up most of Team Annihilation in Northridge. So we can pretty much confirm that Team Annihilation has a new commander, but I haven't uncovered who that is yet. One thing troubles me, though: these guys seem to know the White Wolves' conventional tactics inside out. I've got a bad feeling about this.
disp_detail.9341504: Based on the intel you provided, we discovered enemy signal relay devices in three key locations in the TV Station. It's clear that our comms channels have been monitored for a long time. After we removed the devices and completed a full internal security sweep, the enemy assault slowed down. The pressure on our front lines has eased significantly.
disp_detail.9341607: I never thought it could be him... No wonder the intel leaks were so accurate! Anyway, this thread has come to its end, and Maxim will handle the traitor. With that threat eliminated, we can focus on the transport plan again. Piers 5 and 7 are the most logical loading points, so I've sent an elite squad of White Wolves to scout the area for security. I wouldn't think Team Annihilation would go so far, but just to be on the safe side, I want to set up Pier 5 as a decoy. I need you to gather some reliable operators from the Dark Zone, and when the time is right, they'll disguise themselves as White Wolves and guard Pier 5.
disp_detail.9411506: I never thought we'd meet here. Oh, I don't mean you. I'm referring to an old acquaintance... or rather, an enemy with whom I share a tangled history. I need you to do me a favor. Take this symbol and place it at the main entrance of the TV Station. It's a declaration from the Crows, a sign heralding the Raven's homecoming.
disp_detail.9421504: The chaos has drawn the guard battalion's attention. Things are developing exactly as we intended. Now, head to the Armory and add the next chapter to our "story." I need you to go deep into the Armory and plant new traces that align with the logic of our earlier actions. Keep the enemy's focus firmly fixed on this false trail.
disp_detail.9341601: Operator, good work on that last operation. You secured those key supplies and made Team Annihilation eat dirt! With your connections in the Dark Zone, you've probably already guessed how hot this "cargo" is. Thanks for the assist. We recently got orders to safely transport this cargo back to Tevila territory. I doubt Team Annihilation will let this go, so it's only going to get more dangerous from here. I need you on standby—expect a new commission soon.
disp_detail.9341613: I've received word from the TV Station that the Airport fight is cooling down, but it seems too early to me. Team Annihilation would never back down so easily, so they must be up to something. I hope it's just my imagination, but to be on the safe side, I need you to head to Pier 7 now and prepare to provide backup around the perimeter. I hope we won't need you, but get there as fast as you can anyway.
disp_detail.9341508: Operator, I need you to work with the White Wolf Squad to intercept the Apostle Squad's retreat. Slow them down and buy more time for Maxim's next move.
disp_detail.9341503: Operator, the enemy has taken advantage of a gap in the TV Station's defenses to launch a fierce attack. The squad of White Wolves holding the perimeter has taken heavy casualties. I strongly suspect the enemy already knows the layout of our internal defenses. I'm adjusting our deployments now, but I need you to sweep all suspicious areas inside the TV Station and locate any unusual signal sources or communication devices.
disp_detail.9011501: Operator, there have been some strange rumors about the Valley circulating in the Dark Zone recently, saying that things have changed there. It probably isn't a big deal, but if you're in the area, you should check it out and see what's really going on.
disp_detail.9341614: I've gotta be straight with you, Operator. Before departing, Vladlen verified the cargo contents—and it's anything but conventional weaponry. It contains original samples and the "results" of human experiments Toland conducted at the TV Station. I didn't want to tell you so soon, but since you're already headed for Pier 7, you need to know what's at stake. If this cargo falls into the hands of Team Annihilation, Tevila's international standing will be highly compromised. Toland certainly wants the cargo back, too—because if the data goes public, their experiments in Kamona will be exposed. It seems that Vladlen and I both misjudged the importance of this cargo from the very start. And now... we've got to face the consequences.
disp_detail.9341501: Operator, we just received a transmission from the Airport. A group of unidentified hostiles has attacked our outer strongholds. Communications with the outer strongholds have been completely cut off, and we don't know the extent of our losses. Your mission is to head to the Airport immediately, assess the situation, and try to restore the White Wolf Squad's comms channel there.
disp_detail.9341612: Operator, you're doing well at the Airport. The convoy is ready, and I'll personally lead the Flag Squad to escort the cargo. The timing of the Airport attack was unusual, so as a precaution, I've deployed some empty vehicles to act as decoys within the convoy. Keep supporting Maxim at the Airport and await my orders.
disp_detail.9341611: I've reviewed the combat reports from the Airport, and you did well, Operator. However, the enemy commander seems very familiar with the tactics of the White Wolves, as Team Annihilation didn't operate as they usually do. Maybe I'm overthinking it, but our enemy might not even be the Apostles anymore. In any case, the convoy can't wait any longer. The transport fleet docks at dawn, and I've got to escort the cargo myself, so I'm leaving the Airport in your and Maxim's hands in the meantime. Contact me ASAP if the situation changes. I'll keep Vladlen up to date with my intel.
disp_detail.9341610: Change of plans, Operator. Something's gone wrong, and the Airport is under attack. The Team Annihilation forces are much larger than we expected, and Blackgold is involved as well. They're likely targeting the North Terminal, so let's scrap the decoy plan. I need you to hurry and lead your operators to rendezvous with my team of White Wolves. Once you've linked up, race to the Airport and support Maxim. We absolutely must hold the Control Tower and the Terminal. If we lose either one, the entire transport plan is kaput. This will be a tough fight, but I promise the pay will make it worth your while. I'm counting on you.
disp_detail.9411517: Wolf cubs have appeared at the Armory and are surrounding the support squad we previously deployed. I need you to create enough chaos elsewhere to draw off the White Wolves' forces. As for the Armory itself... I will personally lead a squad to carve out an escape route for the Crows.
