disp_detail.9411513: The wolf cubs have left the den, attempting to retake the outer strongholds. Give them no quarter—break them completely. This isn't a fair fight; it is pure, unadulterated vengeance. Their alpha will surely learn of what happens here, and it will drive her to make a fatal miscalculation.
disp_detail.9411523: The wolf cubs attacked the stronghold. They've taken the "cargo." Intercepted intel shows they're transporting it to the TV Station. I can sense a trap—this mission will be extremely dangerous. But the orders are clear: no matter the cost, we must stop this transport. I hope you'll join the Crows for one more journey.
disp_detail.9411524: The Wolves are attempting to coordinate with the guard battalion to pick off the Crows. But how strong can the guard battalion be outside the safety of their Armory? I'll leave this area to you. I'll dispatch a squad to help you hold off a pincer attack from the flanks. As for me, I'll personally lead the Crows and tear this net apart from the front.
disp_detail.9411505: The Wolves have built a fortified den inside the TV Station. The Crows have launched several assaults, but have been unable to breach their defenses. I need an elite operative like you to infiltrate their position and find out the details of their defensive layout. Additionally, there's something off about the identity of their "alpha"—she gives me an inexplicable sense of familiarity. You are to investigate this as part of the mission.
disp_detail.9411515: The Wolves executed their tactics better than I expected and weathered the worst of it. Now, the Crows need to pull back temporarily and gather strength for the next hunt. Your mission is to recall the assault squads in the TV Station and Airport areas. Have them regroup on the perimeter and await orders.
disp_detail.9411504: This phase of the cleanup is complete. The results align with expectations, and no unexpected incidents occurred. You've once again proven your capabilities. That said, the appetizers are over—the main course is about to be served. If you choose to continue working with us, the company will reward you accordingly. And I, for one, would be happy to share a few more "stories" with you.
disp_detail.9411607: The White Wolves have gathered a squad of operators just as skilled as you to clear out our strongholds in Floranpino. Our tactical objectives have been achieved, so the Crows don't need to waste time here. Soldier, I need you to lead your squad to place some "smoke grenades" in the Valley. The Crows will slowly withdraw from Floranpino, and once your mission is complete, I'll see you in Guoyapos.
disp_detail.9431604: It seems money has a far greater influence on that friend than loyalty to their country. With this intel, Talia won't be able to prepare her transport plan in peace. Expert, a highly skilled Task Force is about to arrive at the Airport. I need you to seize the opportunity and slow them down. Do your best—I want to see who has the better eye for talent, Talia or me.
disp_detail.9401505: Combining your intel with what I uncovered at the Farm, it's clear they've stashed some "goodies" there. Honestly, I have no idea what it is, but if it's important to them, we need to find out. Friend, bring your team to the Farm and rendezvous with me. We'll search the entire area and get to the bottom of this.
disp_detail.9411516: Feathers report that the investigation at the Armory isn't going well. The Guard Corps has begun hunting down the Crows. Brady is a formidable officer among the opportunists of the old era. Revan once spoke of his 4th Armored Brigade. I need you to help the Crows get away. Attack the Guard Corps' deployed scout squads, draw their attention, and cover our personnel's withdrawal. I'm also dispatching an elite squad to take direct command of the follow-up operations at the Armory.
disp_detail.9011615: A seasoned expert doesn't depend on their gear; they master it.
disp_detail.9011616: A seasoned expert doesn't depend on their gear; they master it.
disp_detail.9011617: A seasoned expert doesn't depend on their gear; they master it.
disp_detail.9011618: A seasoned expert doesn't depend on their gear; they master it.
disp_detail.9011619: A seasoned expert doesn't depend on their gear; they master it.
disp_detail.9411606: The op was a success. The White Wolves have reinforcements en route, so the next objective is clear: that squad must not be allowed to arrive safely. It's not just about thinning their numbers—it's about breaking their rhythm. Head-on fighting is no problem for a disciplined crew, but an endless string of contingencies will cause them to crumble. The Crows will support you, soldier. Do all you can to inflict pain on those reinforcements. I want to give them a wound they can't ignore.
disp_detail.9421505: The Armory is Guard Corps territory, and Renoir—the one in control there—is not someone to be underestimated. The southern front is currently deadlocked in Marulos, which means the Armory's defenses are on high alert. Even Team Annihilation would face heavy resistance if they tried to investigate. Needless to say, it will be just as dangerous for you. Exercise extreme caution during this mission.
disp_detail.9421502: The plan is simple. Fake an escape trail in Marulos. Make it obvious. Let Team Annihilation think they've found a lead, when in fact you're leading them astray. This will both disrupt their judgment and buy Kurt the time and space he needs to move.
disp_detail.9421503: Remember, the art of deception lies in restraint. Sometimes, one or two "accidental" flaws can make the whole performance seem more real. Go to the Farm, create some controlled chaos, and leave behind the "necessary" traces before you extract.
disp_detail.9401603: The cargo's safe, so now it's time to make Team Annihilation pay. I've got skilled trackers tailing the squad that hit our convoy, and right now, they're holed up in a secret stronghold waiting for their next job. They must think they're nice and safe, eh? Well, get ready to move, pal. We're gonna show 'em what a real ambush looks like. Tooth for a tooth, right?
disp_detail.9431608: While the White Wolves have all their attention focused on that idiot, I need you to make a trip to the TV Station. An old colleague of mine bribed a mole inside. I want to use them to monitor Talia's next moves. Before that, though, I need you to gauge this person's attitude—see if they have any inclination for a double-cross. Because there's nothing I hate more than being betrayed.
disp_detail.9411525: The guard battalion was as weak as I predicted, but the Wolves' bite was fiercer than anticipated. The "cargo" has now been moved near the Armory. There's a key stronghold controlled by the Guard Corps there, and Brady's Armory Bodyguards will be our primary opposition. The division of labor remains the same: I'll break through the escort team, and you'll deal with the flank support.
disp_detail.9411608: The non-stop fighting has run the White Wolves ragged, and we've found a hole in the Airport's defenses. It's time. Soldier, I need you to cut the power to the facilities around the Airport to distract the guards around the perimeter. Once the wolf cubs have left their den, the Crows will storm the Terminal and destroy the landing strip.
disp_detail.9411508: The trail suggests they've already left the Farm, but my intuition is warning me—this escape route is too "perfect," and that makes me uneasy. I need you to return to Marulos and conduct a thorough recheck. Gather enough intel to either confirm or disprove my hunch.
disp_detail.9401605: The traitor seems to know he's being followed, since he's been pulling lots of stunts on the road. But he's no professional, so his tricks won't fool us. I'd wager that he thinks he'll soon be safe and sound—so he'll relax and lead us to his next stop.
disp_detail.9431607: That idiot made it out. And just as I expected, they didn't even notice that they were being tailed. It looks like the team tracking them is being led by that gamer kid. Expert, I need you to go to the Airport and pretend to protect that idiot. Lead them on a wild goose chase around the Farm a couple of times, and then head to the Northridge meeting. After the meeting, those people will definitely send someone to track you as well. I trust your skills—handle it cleanly, and don't leave a trail.
disp_detail.9431609: That idiot finally reached Northridge, but they still haven't realized that they're being followed. Expert, their fate is in your hands. I'll sync the location of the Viper's stronghold to you. Leave markings along the way for that idiot and lure them there. Finally, make sure to finish them off before that gamer kid catches them.
disp_detail.9341602: That cargo Maxim had you move was just the tip of the iceberg. More of it is still hidden across Marulos. Team Annihilation are unusually well-informed, which makes me suspect someone in the White Wolves is being paid off. To prevent further leaks, the Flag Squad can't show their faces directly. I need you, working as an operator, to head to these stash locations and activate the coordinate locators Maxim set up. Once activated, Maxim will handle the rest of the transport. While you do that, I'll have the White Wolf squads sweep the outskirts of Marulos and take out the Team Annihilation stronghold to cause a distraction. Their eyes will be on me—that's your best window.
disp_detail.9341506: Maxim sent word. They've reached the Airport safely and have taken control. The enemy isn't completely eliminated, but they no longer pose a serious threat to the Airport. The ball's in our court now. It's time to switch from defense to offense.
disp_detail.9341505: You should be familiar with Maxim. During the last operation at the Airport, he was the one who lifted the lockdown on the Control Area for us from the inside. I'm sending him to the Airport to take command and help ease the situation there. Operator, I need you to pose as a support squad that failed to break through. Draw the enemy scouts' attention and mislead them so that Maxim's squad can move unseen.
disp_detail.9341509: Maxim always has a plan. He intends to set bait to force Team Annihilation into our pre-set ambush. Even if they realize it's a trap, they'll have no other choice. Operator, you have two options: join my ambush team for a direct assault, or work with Maxim's transport team to covertly move and hide the remaining cargo.
disp_detail.9411603: Message from the Nest: The convoy's course has not changed. Personnel count matches the pre-departure intel, so stick to the plan. You're responsible for leading the Crows' attack on the Guard Corps squad to sever the link between the two sides. I'll deal with those annoying little wolf cubs escorting the cargo.
disp_detail.9411518: The Crows' main force managed to extract, but the White Wolves captured the lead Crow. His expertise wasn't enough to see him through. The Farm's secrets have been leaked, and we were a step too slow. We must return to the Farm at once and assess the situation.
disp_detail.9411510: The Crows will continue tracking their trail. Meanwhile, I need you to put the investigation mission on hold, gear up, and proceed to the Farm to carry out a covert operation. An elite squad will rendezvous with you there. Your objective is to establish a completely secure zone in the Farm area to provide cover for the upcoming transfer operation.
disp_detail.9411511: The Crows have come under attack from the guard battalion on the east side of the Farm, where the Crows are conducting a search. This isn't the Crows' home turf, and they lack the means to mount an effective counterattack. I'll direct them to create a suitable "hunting ground" for you. Get your squad in position and be ready to deal a crippling blow to the guard battalion when the time is right.
disp_detail.9431808: We've discovered that a secret passage known only to the company was activated not long ago, so it appears that some other force has set its sights on the company's cargo as well. Transfer command of the perimeter assault to someone else, Expert. Then take a few skilled operatives and infiltrate the TV Station disguised as White Wolves. Once inside, head to the director's office on the second floor and await orders.
disp_detail.9441817: Everything is ready, Operator—now it's up to you. Use the Team Annihilation disguises to launch an assault on the TV Station's surface facilities under the cover of night. Attack the White Wolf guards on the surface to draw more of their forces above ground. My special forces squad will infiltrate the TV Station disguised as White Wolves and carry out the plan. The success of this operation depends on how much chaos you can create. Stay alert, we're counting on you.
disp_detail.9441820: No! This isn't what we agreed on. This wasn't the original objective... Operator, something has gone wrong with the underground operation. My squad is withdrawing through the ventilation duct you used before. I need you to get to the Photography Area immediately to cover them and stop any enemies from getting near the duct.
disp_detail.9431802: You did well, Expert. You didn't buy us much time, but it was enough. We could have had some more fun, but that extra manpower they brought in was quite skilled. If they weren't so good at assault operations like that, the response team wouldn't have collapsed so fast. But never mind—it's not worth dwelling on. The company's reinforcements are almost here, and they'll be coming over from the tarmac soon. The documents are nearly all burned up, so let's hold out just a bit longer and follow their chopper out of here.
disp_detail.9431806: The company's sent us a new mission, expert. To avenge our defeat at Pier 7, we need to recover some cargo from beneath the TV Station. Time is short, so we've got to focus our efforts and get this right on the first try. Talia is reinforcing the TV Station's defenses as we speak, so the slower we move, the worse our chances get—and that's why we need to strike fast.
disp_detail.9431801: I have some interesting news, Expert. Our scouts discovered some little spies just east of here. Turns out they're White Wolves disguised as Family members, which means our stronghold is probably compromised and we need to relocate immediately. However, our defenses are going to have to hold up a little while longer while we dispose of our data. I've already dispatched the emergency team, but we need to stall the White Wolves longer than that. Expert, I need you to go to the Valley and cause some trouble for the White Wolves gathered there. Don't go in there all guns blazing though—I want you back here ASAP.
disp_detail.9431803: Welcome to Northridge, expert. Abyss put up a good fight, and excluding the response team that did all the dirty work, we barely took any losses ourselves. Moving forward, all future jobs will be assigned from here. This place is cold, remote, and really inconvenient compared to Floranpino, but there's one upside: the entire place is covered in snow, making it easier for us to do our work without anyone breathing down our neck. And when I think about it that way, this place starts to grow on me. I'm sure those squad psychos will be pleased, anyway.
disp_detail.9441821: The mission encountered a complication. Something unexpected happened beneath the TV Station, and now a disaster is sure to unfold. During the underground brawl, a secure room was deliberately opened, releasing a special mutant. The creature is now missing and has likely escaped toward the Bay Area via the underground tracks. I fear Kamona could soon face a severe zombie threat.
disp_detail.9441803: The intel you brought back has been useful. Combining your leads with my own intel, that elite Toland squad is likely hiding in a military isolation zone on the western side of the Valley. That place used to be a Committee stronghold, and now it seems that was mostly Toland's doing as well. Now that we're pointed in the right direction, the rest should be straightforward.
disp_detail.9441802: As you probably know, the Flag Squad took heavy losses at the hands of that special Team Annihilation squad a while back. Fortunately, the commander had a backup plan, so Team Annihilation didn't achieve perfect success. Now, the Tevila military is scrambling to track down that squad. I happen to have some leads, and I want your help in checking them out.
disp_detail.9441815: Well done. With these Team Annihilation disguises, we can move on to the next step of our plan. Operator, put on these disguises and head to the Armory to "borrow" some gear. If possible, try to leave behind some clues so that the Guard Corps notices your appearance.
disp_detail.9431807: Our informant in Espinos has reported that not long ago, multiple White Wolf squads departed there to reinforce Guoyapos, and we can use this intel to carry out a decoy operation. Team Annihilation is fully equipped with White Wolf gear so they can blend in amid the chaos at the TV Station. And so, Expert, I need you to lead an elite squad—disguised as Team Annihilation—to attack the TV Station's perimeter. Meanwhile, we'll filter through the gaps in their defenses to infiltrate.
disp_detail.9251802: There's definitely something weird going on at the Port. Whatever it is, I hope it doesn't come to the Armory. Before things get out of hand, Operator, I want you to go and purchase supplies from the Dark Zone Black Market—I'm talking fuel, drinking water, and non-perishable food. Once you've got everything, tell Ajax to send some of the guard battalion over to transport it all back.
disp_detail.9011802: The plague in the Port area is still escalating. A few days ago, due to the discovery of a large number of infected individuals in the apartments, the Twilight Apartments—a large community at the Port—were locked down by the navy. According to available data from observations, infected residents will experience a mild fever and blurred consciousness in the early stages. Within just a few days, their condition will deteriorate rapidly, their central nervous systems will overheat, and they'll eventually lose self-awareness. Derwin is considering expanding the lockdown to include the New Havana Apartments and the Repair Shop near the Twilight Apartments.
disp_detail.9011803: The outbreak at the Port is out of control. After the New Havana Apartments and the Repair Shop fell one after another, Derwin ordered the navy to retreat to the Port Authority and defend the Polaris. Since the outbreak, the White Wolves seem to have had the most foresight—they transferred their squads from various places in advance and set up outposts along the Port's main roads, driving all residents with suspected symptoms back into the Port. Operator, I feel like something big is about to happen. You should be extra careful during this time and keep a close eye out for anything suspicious.
disp_detail.9041803: The virus spread at the Port is still accelerating, and Derwin is preparing to cut off the connecting routes between the Port and the Bay Area. The ex-navy forces he leads have retreated to the Port Authority, planning to rely on it and their warships to resist the crisis. The Tevila military command has notified the Committee of this crisis. I believe that soon, Committee forces will take over the perimeter lockdown of the Port and the Bay Area. In the meantime, the White Wolves' temporary garrison forces near the Airport might be drawn down further. The White Wolves' outposts that are setting up the temporary lockdown line need more supplies. I need you to protect their supply squad and head to the various outposts to deliver supplies.
disp_detail.9251804: Something bad is happening at the Farm—I'm getting unconfirmed reports of human-like monsters. The extraction route the guard battalion was going to use might be too dangerous now. Operator, I need you to go to the Farm and investigate any monster activity in the locations we got the reports from. I then want you to give Ajax a route assessment based on what you learn, so that he can decide whether to proceed as planned or modify the extraction plan.
disp_detail.9431804: You've only just arrived at Northridge, so you're probably not so familiar with the place yet. Expert, help me prepare some supplies to distribute to the Team Annihilation strongholds scattered around Northridge. It's grunt work, sure, but at this point, your squad's the best fit for it.
disp_detail.9441808: The design of the power room is basically the same as in the Security Department blueprints. So while it appears that Toland modified the underground command center, he also retained some of the MNST-era facilities. These old drawings are more useful than I expected—they'll help us sketch the layout of the TV Station's underground areas more quickly.
disp_detail.9041806: There have been a number of suspected mutant incidents throughout Kamona, but most appear to be clustered in the Bay Area. The Committee's troops are already en route, and the zombie rapid response team is being assembled. I need you to collect as much information as possible from the Dark Zone about these mutant incidents before the Committee forces officially take over responsibility for the lockdown. I must assess whether these incidents risk impacting construction of the Gungnir Base in the north of Kamona—it's one of the most important bases in the world, and neither Tevila nor the Committee are going to let this crisis affect Project Gungnir.
disp_detail.9441819: Bad news. A real Team Annihilation squad suddenly appeared underground and attacked us from behind. The White Wolves and Team Annihilation are locked in a three-way fight with us. Fortunately, you shut down the backup power just in time. Under the cover of darkness, my squad managed to break away from the brawl before the power was restored. With the White Wolves and Team Annihilation busy fighting each other, we can continue with the original plan.
disp_detail.9041801: Don't be nervous, soldier. I'm going to brief you on the current situation. What I'm about to tell you is highly classified, so keep your mouth shut. Not long ago, a special infected being carrying a high-risk virus escaped from the TV Station underground and fled to the Bay Area. Based on its external biological changes, we've named it a "mutant". The virus it carries is highly infectious and can spread through bodily fluids. It causes the infected's body to deform after a certain period, making them lose their minds and become extremely aggressive. To curb the spread of the virus and prevent a disaster, the White Wolves in the Kamona region will be fully deployed to Guoyapos to build a line of defense. So, during this time, I need you to lead a vanguard squad as my messengers to relay or execute necessary orders on my behalf.
disp_detail.9041802: Soldier, a special "plague" has appeared at the Port and continues to spread. What's suspicious is that its speed and method of transmission don't match what we previously knew. There might be a mutated virus, or maybe the virus carried by the escaped mutant doesn't entirely match our records. Regardless, the crisis has begun to spread. Derwin received our warning, sealed off parts of the underground water network, and is using an independent water supply system. I need you to go to Marulos on my behalf and send a message to the Guard Corps. Warn them to pull back their defense lines as soon as possible and focus on defending the Guoyapos area.
disp_detail.9251803: Thanks to the intel you brought back from Guoyapos, we didn't have to fight the other factions over supplies. We've been having communication issues with the Farm these past couple of days, so I want you to go there and tell Ajax to pull the main guard battalion forces back to the Armory once they've finished transporting the supplies.
disp_detail.9341808: The Security Department are positive that the fire in the Airport was started deliberately. Judging from the inventory of damaged supplies, a lot of the White Wolves' equipment was stolen by the perpetrators beforehand which, in addition to the Guard Corps' missing equipment, leads me to believe that Team Annihilation might be planning to disguise themselves as White Wolves in order to gain access to the TV Station. We cannot have the TV Station turn into another Pier 7. We'll make preparations for any attacks that might come this way.
disp_detail.9041807: Conquer these lands and make your name known to all.
disp_detail.9041808: Conquer these lands and make your name known to all.
disp_detail.9041809: Conquer these lands and make your name known to all.
disp_detail.9041810: Conquer these lands and make your name known to all.
disp_detail.9041811: Conquer these lands and make your name known to all.
disp_detail.9341803: It's a shame we couldn't find any useful clues in this stronghold. The support from Abyss proved to be a real turning point on the battlefield, but in the end we couldn't stop them from retreating by air. The White Wolves' intelligence officers stationed throughout the Dark Zone are currently analyzing the chopper's flight path, and the Intelligence Department is using the data to try and estimate their final destination. Until then, keep looking for clues around here—maybe there's some intelligence lying around that they didn't have time to destroy.
disp_detail.9341805: If only the White Wolves had as wide an intelligence network in Onotos as they do in the Dark Zone... We couldn't find anything out about that squad in Northridge, and they might not even be there. Looks like this quick mission is going to turn into a protracted battle. I'll report back to the Colonel and try to convince him to start expanding the White Wolves' intelligence contacts in the Onotos region. While I'm at it, I'm going to try and butter up Fred to lend us his Forest Man squad to help our intelligence officers with their investigations into Toland's team.
disp_detail.9431809: We're engaged in fierce fighting underground against the Flag Squad, as well as a squad from that mysterious new force. White Wolves are pouring in from the ground-level entrance they currently control, reinforcing their underground squads—and that's where you come in, Expert. I need you to cause chaos inside the TV Station to slow the inflow of White Wolf reinforcements from the ground floor. Don't get bogged down—just keep attacking and retreating. The more chaos you cause, the better.
disp_detail.9341802: Our troops are in position in the Valley. Operator, take your squad to the western side of the Valley and retrieve the supplies we need for the mission from the Temporary Command Post. We'll be launching our attack in three hours.
disp_detail.9441824: I received intel that Vladlen is relocating White Wolf personnel from multiple locations to support Guoyapos—specifically toward the TV Station and the Port. The main forces at the Airport have also been withdrawn to blockade the main roads leading to the Port. This gives us a great opportunity, Operator. Use this window to infiltrate the Airport, set up additional recon equipment, and retrieve the data we collected previously.
disp_detail.9441812: I sent a squad to infiltrate via the secret passage you found in the station director's office. They found that Toland had converted what was originally a storage space into an underground rail station. They even built an underground freight track that leads to the Bay Area. The bad news is that, since the Flag Squad returned early, we had to pause our plan to continue investigating.
disp_detail.9251805: I've received reports of a growing number of humanoid monsters in the Farm. We can't afford to wait anymore! Operator, find Ajax and relay my orders: abandon the original plan and immediately withdraw the guard battalion back to the Armory by whichever route he deems fit!
disp_detail.9441816: Next, we need White Wolf uniforms. According to our intel, both the Airport and Espinos have recently deployed White Wolf soldiers to help defend the TV Station. We can take advantage of the chaos and disguise ourselves as White Wolves to enter the TV Station. From there, we'll use the secret passage in the Director's Office to get underground. There should be some spare White Wolf gear in the Airport's control area. I need you to infiltrate the Airport and steal the uniforms we need, then start a fire in the armory to cover your tracks.
disp_detail.9441810: The structure of the containment zone matches the blueprints as well. I suspect that Toland first checked the facility's structural integrity, then left that section untouched. It's also likely that the test subjects from the lab were held there. I noticed something else, too. The passage connecting the containment zone to the underground storage has been modified. Toland may have converted the space below into some kind of secret facility.
disp_detail.9341809: The enemy are attacking the TV Station's outermost defensive lines from multiple angles, and they've destroyed our external generators. We're running on back-up power for now, and our troops are pulling back closer to the TV Station. I'm concerned that there might be scavengers in disguise hiding in amongst the White Wolves—they must be trying to get to the TV Station Basement. I've posted more sentries at every entrance to the basement, but I'm still not satisfied. Operator, I need you to go and investigate the TV Station perimeter and make sure there's no other way anyone can get in.
disp_detail.9441807: The White Wolves' defenses aren't very tight around the newly discovered passage, so this is our chance, Operator. You must avoid the White Wolf guards at all costs, and retreat immediately if necessary. At this juncture, we simply cannot afford to reveal our intentions in advance.
disp_detail.9441805: The Flag Squad's departure leaves us an opening, a chance to investigate beneath the TV Station. You're already familiar with the above-ground areas of the TV Station, Operator. This time, I need you to infiltrate the underground and map out the White Wolves' deployments down there. But before that, I need you to locate an entrance to the underground area.
disp_detail.9041805: We received intelligence yesterday of confirmed mutant attacks in multiple locations within the Bay Area, and I fear it might only be a matter of time before the entire district falls. Operator, this kind of intel isn't the kind I can just pass to the Guard Corps via the official channels, so I need you to personally go and alert them yourself—without revealing any classified information. Make sure they're thoroughly prepared for an attack coming from Guoyapos.
disp_detail.9341806: Team Annihilation ambushed the Guard Corps again yesterday, destroying some of the equipment given to us by Tevila. They're now asking me to dispatch soldiers to help clear the members of Team Annihilation from the Marulos stronghold. I strongly suspect this is another diversionary tactic, and I'd rather not deploy the White Wolves just yet. But the Guard Corps do need and deserve some extra support. I've apprised the Colonel of the situation, who is now redeploying a small contingent of White Wolves from the Airport and Espinos to plug the gaps in the Guard Corps' defenses. Operator, I'd like you to lead this contingent to the Armory and discuss with Renoir how to clear the Marulos stronghold of Team Annihilation.
disp_detail.9341807: It's been one strange occurrence after another lately. There's been a massive fire in one of the warehouses in the Airport Control Area. Nobody was hurt, but a lot of equipment has been damaged. The Security Department are investigating what caused the fire, but something feels off to me. Or maybe it really was just an accident... Operator, I need you to take a trip to the Dark Zone Black Market and ask around to see if there's been any suspicious activity recently.
disp_detail.9441811: After comparing the TV Station's above-ground and underground blueprints, I've come to a bold conclusion. There may still be a secret passage leading from the TV Station's above-ground areas to the underground. Additionally, given the White Wolves' current security measures, it's very likely that they don't know about this passage. Operator, I need you to go to the station director's office and check for a secret door or hidden room that isn't shown on the blueprints.
disp_detail.9431805: Abyss sent us some interesting intel. Lately, some "strangers" have been snooping around Northridge, and they even got in touch with Fred. Whose people are they? Well, who else? Talia's still trying to find me. She just won't give it a rest, but not a chance, hah! Do me a couple more favors, Expert. Send my regards to those strangers, and give those Forest Men a warning—don't stick your nose where it doesn't belong!
disp_detail.9341801: You should have confirmed this in the briefing, Operator. Our target is Toland's "muscle"—a heavily armed squad from Team Annihilation. According to Security Department intel, they're currently holed up in the military isolation zone just west of the Valley. There's a lot of them, and they're well equipped and well defended. I've already made contact with three partners who have the same target as us, and I need you to go to the Farm and leave a message for them.
disp_detail.9441825: Operator, it's time for us to part ways again. But this time, I won't disappear without saying goodbye. We haven't known each other long but working with you has always been a pleasure. As I expected, I still want to recruit you, but I know you have no desire to be tied to any one faction. Maybe I'm also being a bit selfish. A person like you shouldn't have to follow me to the darker places I've been to on my own volition. Some secrets were never meant to be uncovered, and some paths were never meant to be walked. I can't turn back, but you still have a choice, and I believe you'll make the right one. Goodbye, Operator. I hope that when we meet again, nothing will have changed, and we can still talk like this.
disp_detail.9441818: Operator, my squad encountered heavy resistance underground. The enemy seems to have caught onto our plan. The squad have found an alternate route and are preparing to make a detour to the Containment Zone, but the enemy's defences are too tight for us to move. I need you to find a way into the TV Station as quickly as possible and destroy the backup power supply inside to create a diversion.
disp_detail.9011801: Operator, strange things have been happening at the Port recently. An unknown plague is spreading rapidly there. Both local residents and militants have shown symptoms of infection. Even some of Derwin's navy personnel have caught it. Rumor has it that the plague is spreading through the local water network. Derwin has already shut down multiple water stations in the Port area and restricted his navy's access to water.
disp_detail.9441822: Operator, we coordinated well during the TV Station operation, and all objectives were successfully completed... though there were a few unexpected developments. Soon, I'll move behind the scenes to observe the changes taking place in the Dark Zone, so we might not work together again for a while. Before I leave though, I have one last mission for you. I need you to establish a network of hidden observation points throughout the Dark Zone for me.
disp_detail.9441801: The fact that you've managed to follow the clues all the way here shows that you're even sharper than before, Operator. I heard that while I was away from the Dark Zone, you added a few more notches to your belt. Once is coincidence, and twice is luck, but someone like you who manages to escape unscathed every single time—that's like a character straight out of a spy film. Alright, enough with the pleasantries. Since this is our "first" meeting, you can call me Evita. I'm afraid I have another favor to ask.
disp_detail.9441809: Take this copy of the map, Operator. Start by checking the layout around the power room to see where Toland's lab begins. Use the map to expand your area of operation to regions that haven't been altered much and determine where the White Wolves are stationed in those regions.
disp_detail.9441804: Operator, take this intel to the Farm and send it out on the White Wolves' comms frequency. Tevila will receive the message soon, and I'm sure that MNST won't let it slide. When the time comes, the entire Flag Squad will probably be mobilized, so those two top-tier squads will clash once again in the Military Isolation Zone.
disp_detail.9251801: Operator, can you come here for a minute? I just received orders from the Clan Commander to consolidate our defensive lines, lock down the Armory, and concentrate our defenses in the direction of Guoyapos. I was then advised to abandon all deployments in the Farm and instead bring the main guard battalion force back to the Armory to further shore up the defenses. All I know at the moment is that this is an alert from Tevila, so I was hoping you could go to Guoyapos and see if you can find out if anything strange is going on there.
disp_detail.9341810: Operator, tell the White Wolves to lock down all ground entrances to prevent the mutant from escaping! Team Annihilation breached the basement through a secret tunnel we didn't know about, and attacked our sentries from behind. In the confusion, they released a highly pathogenic mutant from its cell—and the Flag Squad are too busy fighting Team Annihilation to stop it from escaping!
disp_detail.9441813: The TV Station has re-tightened its security, preventing us from infiltrating again. We need to change our approach, or we're at a dead end... Perhaps we can create an opportunity ourselves. I need you to go and talk to someone for me, Operator. He's a former Northern Front explosives expert who's currently living in Marulos. He owes me a favor, and it's come time for him to repay it.
disp_detail.9341804: The White Wolves' intelligence officers have managed to reconstruct the helicopter's flight path: they went through Marulos to get to Onotos. The Intelligence Department believes they are likely heading for Northridge, since Abyss have a certain degree of control in the region. Our chances might be slim, but I want to try and make contact with Fred and see if he can find where Toland's crew have moved their stronghold to. Operator, please go to Northridge and ask Fred if he can do this for us.
disp_detail.9041804: The checkpoints set up by the White Wolves have managed to contain most residents with suspected symptoms of infection, but a small number of them bypassed the main roads and have left the Port via the side streets. Operator, I need you to go to the Airport and give a sitrep to the Commander stationed there, then check the Airport's defenses and determine whether they need reinforcements.
disp_detail.9441806: It seems that even with the Flag Squad gone, the White Wolves have the TV Station underground tightly guarded. This does confirm, however, that the area holds a secret, and that the returned cargo is probably stored there. Using my own intel channels, I obtained an early draft of the blueprints for MNST's underground command center at the TV Station. By comparing the blueprints, I've determined that there must still be some passages that lead from the surface down to the underground.
disp_detail.9011804: Outbreaks similar to the one at the Port have appeared in multiple places across the Dark Zone. Derwin, the White Wolves, and the Guard Corps forces all recently chose similar defensive pullback strategies. They must know something they aren't sharing with the outside world. Floranpino. Operator, I need you to head to Floranpino ASAP to warn Doss and tell the Antonio Family to prepare.
disp_detail.9011805: A seasoned expert doesn't depend on their gear; they master it.
disp_detail.9011806: A seasoned expert doesn't depend on their gear; they master it.
disp_detail.9011807: A seasoned expert doesn't depend on their gear; they master it.
disp_detail.9011808: A seasoned expert doesn't depend on their gear; they master it.
disp_detail.9011809: A seasoned expert doesn't depend on their gear; they master it.
disp_detail.9441823: The observation points were chosen well. They're hidden while still gathering enough intel. Chaos is about to engulf the Dark Zone, and there's nothing I can do to stop it... Operator, I need a favor. I have a good relationship with some of the field merchants in the Dark Zone. I need you to have them discreetly pass along some warning messages.
disp_detail.9441814: For our plan, we'll need a shipment of weapons and gear from an undisclosed source, and the supplies Tevila is providing to the Guard Corps are our best option. Before that, however, we'll need disguises. Operator, you should know a lot about Team Annihilation's strongholds in the Dark Zone. I need you to secure some signature Team Annihilation gear to use as disguises in our op.
disp_detail.9431810: The special forces squad from that unknown faction also had secret intel on the underground lab! They broke into a secure room and released a special mutant that had been held there. They also opened the underground track doors, allowing the mutant to escape and flee toward the Bay Area. Our operation failed, and this is going to be a disaster. We're extracting, Expert. Secure the entrance to the secret passage in the director's office—don't let anyone near it!

FrontEnd.Workbench_ProbabilityNotice: Within-quality weight share is not the research probability. Quality weights and server pity rules are unavailable. Percentages in effects refer to crafting triggers.
FrontEnd.Workbench_OddsExplanation:
Affixes are grouped by formula and quality. Weight shares use the complete original quality pool and do not change with search or filters. Of 721 affixes, 711 have weight 100 and 10 have weight 50; they are not all equally weighted.
The client defines quality-weight and guarantee-count fields, but the corresponding quality table is absent from the available exports and asset manifest. Research candidates and gold/red guarantee progress are supplied by the server. Owned-affix exclusions, sampling without replacement and guarantee priority are unverified, so a two-candidate joint probability is not calculated.
FrontEnd.Workbench_OddsFormula: Within-quality share = affix weight / total weight for the same formula and quality. Only assuming quality is drawn first with no exclusions: candidate chance = quality chance x within-quality share. Quality chance is currently unknown.
FrontEnd.Workbench_ScoreTitle: Score is neither draw probability nor an extra bonus multiplier
FrontEnd.Workbench_ScoreExplanation:
Research score is the sum of equipped affix scores. For the .45 APWC example, the 54-point guaranteed-output affix plus the 66-point material-refund affix totals 120. Their 100% and 25% values describe effect triggers, not research probabilities.
Confirmed uses are score display, friend-formula comparison, default ordering of existing selections, and a confirmation prompt when replacing a higher-scoring combination. Client previews for time, materials, output and research cost do not use score as a multiplier. Suppressed lower-quality affixes still contribute to the displayed score, so a higher score need not mean a better effective result. Other server-side uses cannot be ruled out from client evidence alone.
FrontEnd.Workbench_TwoSlotsExplanation:
Each item can equip at most two affixes. Research combines existing results with server-provided candidates for selection; a desired pair need not be obtained in one research attempt.
All currently researchable formulas have a zero craft-count threshold for slot two. Research-cost reduction and assisting-blueprint bonuses use the highest quality only; a lower-quality duplicate is suppressed, and equal quality keeps the first selection. Other types are marked stackable, but server joint rolls remain unverified, so their percentages are not simply added.
All current exclusive-group IDs are zero, which does not imply every duplicate bonus stacks. The preview includes deterministic time and materials, guaranteed extra output and research cost, not random refunds or time reductions.
FrontEnd.Workbench_SourcesExplanation: Based on existing S7 release recipe, research and affix exports, WorktopModule Lua, and shared game translations. The original release PAK installation directory is no longer available, so it was not freshly exported in this pass. This does not verify live server configuration. Lists 26 enabled recipes, of which 25 support research, excluding 23 disabled recipes.
